subject: Error in if (pkgpath == "") { : argument is of length zero !

messages.author: 190ae65fc9023bd1
messages.subject: Error in if (pkgpath == "") { : argument is of length zero !
parts:
Dear Henrik,

I get a new error when I am trying to check the quality of my chips.
The following code

ae <- ArrayExplorer(csList);
setColorMaps(ae, "sqrt,yellow");
process(ae, interleaved="none");

give

Error in if (pkgpath == "") { : argument is of length zero

where

> csList
[[1]]
AffymetrixCelSet:
Name: casosLola
Tags:
Path: rawData/casosLola/Mapping250K_Nsp
Chip type: Mapping250K_Nsp
Number of arrays: 4
Names: Bf14203, Bf14241, T14203, T14241
Time period: 2006-12-01 11:23:39 -- 2006-12-27 14:06:57
Total file size: 250.68MB
RAM: 0.01MB

[[2]]
AffymetrixCelSet:
Name: casosLola
Tags:
Path: rawData/casosLola/Mapping250K_Sty
Chip type: Mapping250K_Sty
Number of arrays: 4
Names: Bf14203, Bf14241, T14203, T14241
Time period: 2006-12-13 14:41:59 -- 2006-12-28 14:31:25
Total file size: 250.63MB
RAM: 0.01MB

It seems to be related with the EBImage package or some environment
misspecification.
Actually, packageDescription("EBImage") give the same error, and even
the comand sessionInfo().
Note that my version of EBImage is 2.1.24
Best regards. Olivier

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Error in if (pkgpath == "") { : argument is of length zero !
parts:
Update R.utils, i.e.

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
hbLite("R.utils")

and restart R. Your sessionInfo() should report R.utils v0.9.7.

/Henrik

PS. I'll return the other question later. DS.
